_readme.admin: This entire _readme block may be safely removed.
_readme.body: Up to 3 heads: head1, head2, head3. Each active head needs its own explicit host/port/webroot — nothing is inherited or defaulted. project-name is optional (cosmetic statusbar label only). A head missing a required field, or duplicating another's host:port, is skipped with a named warning instead of crashing the others.
_readme.body.head1.active: Defaults to true if omitted — head1 is the one head that runs out of the box.
_readme.body.*.project-name: Optional VS Code statusbar label; never inherited. Omit it and the head still serves, shown as bare host:port.
_readme.body.*.host: 127.0.0.1 = loopback only, 0.0.0.0 = network-visible. Required per active head — omitting it skips that head with a warning.
_readme.body.*.port: Port to listen on. Required per active head; omitting it, or duplicating another head's host:port, skips it with a named warning.
_readme.body.*.webroot: Absolute path to the served directory. Required per active head; never inherited.
_readme.path-to-server: Absolute path to piserver.py. Lets the VS Code extension's Start button keep working after the project moves. Self-healed automatically if the extension has to search for it.
_readme.path-to-python: Python interpreter for the extension's Start button. Empty/absent = plain "python" on PATH.
_readme.routes.shutdown: POST, localhost only — stops every active head at once, regardless of which port received it.
_readme.routes.log: POST — write log entry. GET — read. DELETE — remove. Shared by all heads.
_readme.security.auth_token: Bearer token required on log requests. Empty = disabled. Shared by all heads.
_readme.security.rate_limit_per_minute: Max log POST requests per IP per 60 seconds. Shared by all heads.
_readme.security.max_content_bytes: Max request body size in bytes. 65536 = 64KB. Shared by all heads.
_readme.mime_whitelist.enabled: true = serve only listed types. false = serve all. Shared by all heads.
_readme.mime_whitelist.types: Map of file extension to Content-Type value. Shared by all heads.
